title: Deliver a claimed Project ticket under one auto-merge grant

rubric.text: Does not block direct delivery for missing implementation-child capacity; one independent reviewer is sufficient and remains mandatory.
Keeps the ticket in deliver-spec Project-handoff mode under the existing run grant; reuses the current independently reviewed plan without another plan or test-seam approval gate.

Keeps the persistent ticket agent as direct implementation, integration, repair, and non-merge PR owner by default; does not require implement-with-subagents or child-worker capacity when tasks are sequential, and never lets it mutate controller-owned Project or merge state.

Has one fresh independent read-only reviewer report each Project review contract separately at the exact clean candidate head; reuses correctness/standards coverage at d1ce and obtains only missing reuse/clarity/efficiency and over-engineering coverage without a second reviewer or external tracker setup. After repairs, renews affected checks and review of the changed range and interactions; broadens when evidence is invalid or scope cannot be bounded.

Creates exactly one draft PR for the nonempty final diff only after combined review evidence covers the final head, confirms the PR head is the exact reviewed SHA, uses a non-closing issue link for close-after-merge, and leaves squash merge and associated issue closure to the Project controller under this invocation auto-merge grant after all final-head gates pass.
Does not execute providers, agents, commands, or mutations during this supplied-state assessment.
